$comment: The KernelSU late-load build this target pairs with. CI rebuilds it from
the src/kernelsu submodule; nothing is committed as a binary.
'id' names the published assets (ksud-<id>, kernelsu-<id>.ko). Targets that
load the same module share one id and are built once. klimt takes its own:
the module's vermagic has to be klimt's kernel release, and the other
android15-6.6 target here is a different sublevel.
'kernelRelease' is the exact UTS release the module must report in its
vermagic. The DDK image ships its own release string, so the build
overwrites the generated utsrelease.h and kernel.release with this value
'patchSets' names the patch sets this build takes on top of common. klimt
takes none: the only vendor set that exists is 'galaxy', for Samsung's
KDP/RKP/DEFEX, and HyperOS has none of the three -- which is the same
reason the other Xiaomi target here names none. That is an argument from
what the sets contain, not a measurement on klimt: nothing has late-loaded
a module on this device yet.
'config' is passed to the module build as-is. It gates code inside a patch
set, so it goes with one: with no set named here there is nothing to gate.
